stories.title: Deputies on scene of death investigation in Plant City
stories.summary: The sheriff's office is expected to provide more information during a media briefing Thursday.

stories.title: Polk County approves $20 million for I-4 flyover project to ease congestion on U.S. 27
stories.summary: A new I-4 flyover aims to ease U.S. 27 congestion, with Polk County committing up to $20 million toward the project.

stories.title: Video shows man fleeing from Polk County sergeant, crashing during pursuit
stories.summary: The suspect, Gabriel Jimenez, ran over Sergeant Brett Hermelbracht with his car before fleeing, officials say.

stories.title: St. Pete officer resigns after audit finds he used Flock cameras to look up woman
stories.summary: Officer Jonathan Reisz resigned from the St. Pete Police Department on Sept. 8. The woman declined to press charges.

stories.title: Busch Gardens Tampa Bay announces new water coaster opening in 2027
stories.summary: Simbi Rush is expected to be North America’s first and the world’s fastest launched water coaster.

stories.title: Waymo confirms testing at Tampa International Airport amid nationwide highway suspension
stories.summary: Waymo tells 10 Tampa Bay News it is working toward autonomous taxi service to and from TPA.

stories.title: PWHL brings pro women's hockey to Tampa Bay with a January 2027 showcase game
stories.summary: Tampa and Sunrise, home of the Florida Panthers, are the only Florida stops on this season's tour.

stories.title: Victim identified in Homosassa homicide as deputies continue investigation
stories.summary: The sheriff's office is asking for the public's help in the investigation.

stories.title: Pedestrian killed while trying to cross I-75 in Pasco County: FHP
stories.summary: Troopers say a van hit the man after he walked into the northbound lanes of I-75.

stories.title: Muslim prayer sparks backlash at Bartow City Commission meeting
stories.summary: A Muslim prayer leader opened the Bartow City Commission meeting Monday, prompting a wave of public comments and debate over religious freedom.

stories.title: Suspect arrested after trying to run over sergeant near Winter Haven incident, sheriff's office says
stories.summary: When a sergeant tried to arrest a person with an active warrant, the suspect allegedly tried to run him over, and the sergeant and was "forced" to open fire.

stories.title: MacDill military housing lawsuit grows to 105 families alleging unsafe conditions, mold
stories.summary: The lawsuit now represents 454 people who allege unsafe living conditions at MacDill Air Force Base. 10 Tampa Bay News first reported on similar complaints in 2019.
